topic.title: Variational Inference and Posterior Optimization
topic.overview: Variational inference approximates an intractable posterior by optimizing a simpler distribution. Its accuracy depends both on the chosen family and divergence and on whether noisy optimization reaches a good solution. These papers examine richer approximations, annealing, sampling connections, gradient estimators, and convergence diagnostics for that coupled problem.
topic.whyItMatters: A flexible approximation can still give misleading uncertainty if optimization fails. Separating approximation error from optimization error helps users judge posterior results and choose procedures that are computationally practical without silently becoming unreliable.
topic.evolution: Early representatives investigate response corrections and contrastive divergence. Later work bridges sampling with variational approximations and develops semi-implicit or mixture families. The 2020–2026 evidence increasingly analyzes black-box optimization itself, including stopping rules, proximal parameterizations, and how second-order Price gradients explain apparent differences between parameter-space and Wasserstein approaches.
openQuestions: Can diagnostics distinguish a poor variational family from incomplete optimization?
When do second-order gradient estimators repay their additional computational cost?

papers.tldr: A tighter Jensen inequality links model repulsion to a generalization bound and yields a new particle variational inference method.

papers.title: MCMC Variational Inference via Uncorrected Hamiltonian Annealing
papers.tldr: Uncorrected Hamiltonian Annealing produces differentiable lower bounds that enable gradient-based tuning of an AIS-like inference procedure.

papers.title: Mixture weights optimisation for Alpha-Divergence Variational Inference
papers.tldr: The paper proves convergence for mixture-weight Power Descent and introduces Rényi Descent through its connection to Entropic Mirror Descent.

papers.title: Nested Variational Inference
papers.tldr: Nested variational inference learns proposals and intermediate distributions at multiple sampling levels, improving reported sample-quality measures.

papers.title: Online Variational Filtering and Parameter Learning
papers.tldr: A variational method learns hidden states and model parameters online without revisiting observations or increasing per-step update cost over time.

papers.title: Structured Stochastic Gradient MCMC
papers.tldr: A non-parametric inference scheme uses earlier samples to control coordinate dependencies, improving convergence speed and/or accuracy in the evaluated models.

papers.title: Surrogate Likelihoods for Variational Annealed Importance Sampling
papers.tldr: A jointly learned surrogate likelihood supports data subsampling in hybrid Bayesian inference while providing a fidelity–computation trade-off.

papers.title: Variational Inference with Locally Enhanced Bounds for Hierarchical Models
papers.tldr: Locally tightened variational bounds improve hierarchical-model inference while supporting subsampling with unbiased gradients.

papers.title: Black-box coreset variational inference
papers.tldr: A black-box variational framework makes Bayesian coreset construction applicable to difficult models such as Bayesian neural networks.

papers.title: Gradient Estimation with Discrete Stein Operators
papers.tldr: Discrete Stein operators provide adaptive control variates that reduce gradient variance without extra target-function evaluations.

papers.title: Markov Chain Score Ascent: A Unifying Framework of Variational Inference with Markovian Gradients
papers.tldr: MCSA unifies variational inference methods using Markov-chain gradients and motivates a parallel variant with tighter variance bounds and better reported performance.

papers.title: On the detrimental effect of invariances in the likelihood for variational inference
papers.tldr: Likelihood invariances can worsen mean-field variational underfitting by creating a posterior approximation gap that vanishes as the approximation returns to the prior.

papers.title: Rethinking Variational Inference for Probabilistic Programs with Stochastic Support
papers.tldr: SDVI improves inference for stochastic-support programs by decomposing them into static-support pieces with separately constructed variational guides.

papers.title: VaiPhy: a Variational Inference Based Algorithm for Phylogeny
papers.tldr: VaiPhy combines coordinate-ascent updates with specialized tree and branch-length samplers to accelerate approximate Bayesian phylogenetic inference.

papers.title: Variational inference via Wasserstein gradient flows
papers.tldr: Wasserstein gradient flows provide principled Gaussian and Gaussian-mixture variational inference methods with strong guarantees for log-concave targets.

papers.title: Coin Sampling: Gradient-Based Bayesian Inference without Learning Rates
papers.tldr: Coin-betting-based particle methods perform Bayesian inference without learning rates and achieve comparable performance in the reported examples.

papers.title: Efficient preconditioned stochastic gradient descent for estimation in latent variable models
papers.tldr: Fisher-information preconditioning yields a stochastic-gradient estimator with convergence guarantees for general latent-variable models.

papers.title: Forward-Backward Gaussian Variational Inference via JKO in the Bures-Wasserstein Space
papers.tldr: FB-GVI uses Wasserstein geometry and a split KL objective to obtain Gaussian variational inference guarantees under different target-distribution assumptions.

papers.title: Practical and Matching Gradient Variance Bounds for Black-Box Variational Bayesian Inference
papers.tldr: For smooth, quadratically growing log-likelihoods, BBVI satisfies a matching gradient-variance bound tied to SGD theory, with favorable dimensional scaling for mean-field parameterizations.

papers.title: A Rigorous Link between Deep Ensembles and (Variational) Bayesian Methods
papers.tldr: A distribution-level optimization framework connects deep ensembles with Bayesian methods and yields interacting ensembles with convergence guarantees.

papers.title: Differentiable Sampling of Categorical Distributions Using the CatLog-Derivative Trick
papers.tldr: CatLog yields an unbiased gradient estimator for independent categorical variables with provably lower variance than REINFORCE.

papers.title: Hierarchical Semi-Implicit Variational Inference with Application to Diffusion Model Acceleration
papers.tldr: HSIVI learns multilayer distribution approximations that improve Bayesian inference expressiveness and can accelerate diffusion sampling using pretrained score networks.

papers.title: Latent SDEs on Homogeneous Spaces
papers.tldr: Restricting latent stochastic dynamics to structured spaces simplifies inference and delivers competitive time-series results despite reduced model diversity.

papers.title: NAS-X: Neural Adaptive Smoothing via Twisting
papers.tldr: NAS-X combines reweighted wake-sleep with smoothing sequential Monte Carlo to improve inference and learning in sequential latent variable models.

papers.title: On the Convergence of Black-Box Variational Inference
papers.tldr: The paper establishes BBVI convergence guarantees and shows how proximal SGD avoids rate limitations caused by certain scale parameterizations.

papers.title: Particle-based Variational Inference with Generalized Wasserstein Gradient Flow
papers.tldr: GWG broadens the geometry and regularization of particle-based inference, with convergence guarantees and an adaptive metric-selection variant.

papers.title: Provable convergence guarantees for black-box variational inference
papers.tldr: A quadratic gradient-noise bound enables convergence guarantees for proximal and projected stochastic optimization in dense Gaussian variational inference.

papers.title: Variational Inference with Gaussian Score Matching
papers.tldr: Gaussian score-matching variational inference uses closed-form local updates and reaches comparable posterior approximation quality with substantially fewer gradient evaluations in reported experiments.

papers.title: VaRT: Variational Regression Trees
papers.tldr: VaRT uses variational Bayesian inference over stochastic decision trees and reports competitive regression performance across 18 datasets.

papers.title: Batch and match: black-box variational inference with a score-based divergence
papers.tldr: BaM uses score-based matching and closed-form Gaussian updates to reduce gradient evaluations in tested variational inference problems.

papers.title: Differentiable Annealed Importance Sampling Minimizes The Jensen-Shannon Divergence Between Initial and Target Distribution
papers.tldr: DAIS has a variational-inference interpretation in the many-transition limit, and its learned initial distribution often improves empirical uncertainty estimates.

papers.title: Efficient Mixture Learning in Black-Box Variational Inference
papers.tldr: MISVAE and two new objective estimators make variational inference with hundreds of mixture components more parameter-efficient and faster.

papers.title: Kernel Semi-Implicit Variational Inference
papers.tldr: Kernel SIVI replaces an inner optimization with an explicit kernel-based solution and provides convergence guarantees for the resulting inference method.

papers.title: Logistic Variational Bayes Revisited
papers.tldr: A tighter softplus-expectation bound improves variational Bayesian classification without additional variational parameters and computes significantly faster than Monte Carlo methods.

papers.title: Online Variational Sequential Monte Carlo
papers.tldr: Online VSMC learns state-space-model parameters and adapts particle proposals as data arrive, with asymptotic convergence guarantees.

papers.title: Provably Scalable Black-Box Variational Inference with Structured Variational Families
papers.tldr: Certain structured variational families reduce BBVI’s dataset-size dependence in iteration complexity from quadratic to linear.

papers.title: Reparameterized Importance Sampling for Robust Variational Bayesian Neural Networks
papers.tldr: RIS improves sampling in variational Bayesian neural networks, with reported gains in convergence, prediction, and out-of-distribution uncertainty estimation.

papers.title: Theoretical Guarantees for Variational Inference with Fixed-Variance Mixture of Gaussians
papers.tldr: The paper gives objective-descent and approximation-error guarantees for variational inference with fixed-covariance Gaussian mixtures.

papers.title: Understanding Stochastic Natural Gradient Variational Inference
papers.tldr: Stochastic NGVI has a proved O(1/T) rate for conjugate likelihoods, while non-conjugate cases expose a non-convex optimization obstacle.

papers.title: Asymptotics of Alpha-Divergence Variational Inference Algorithms with Exponential Families
papers.tldr: The paper establishes conditional convergence guarantees for alpha-divergence variational inference and introduces an unbiased sampling-based alternative.

papers.title: Bayesian Online Natural Gradient (BONG)
papers.tldr: BONG simplifies online Bayesian updates with a single natural-gradient step that is exact for conjugate models and empirically efficient beyond them.

papers.title: EigenVI: score-based variational inference with orthogonal function expansions
papers.tldr: EigenVI fits flexible probability approximations through score matching that reduces to a minimum eigenvalue problem.

papers.title: Fearless Stochasticity in Expectation Propagation
papers.tldr: A natural-gradient interpretation yields expectation-propagation updates that remain stable and are most sample-efficient with single-sample estimates.

papers.title: Globally Convergent Variational Inference
papers.tldr: A neural posterior estimation method has a conditional global-convergence guarantee in a fixed-kernel asymptotic regime, with supporting finite-network experiments.

papers.title: Particle Semi-Implicit Variational Inference
papers.tldr: Particle Variational Inference uses particles to directly optimize the ELBO without a parametric assumption on the mixing distribution.

papers.title: Sharpness-Aware Minimization Activates the Interactive Teaching's Understanding and Optimization
papers.tldr: The paper connects co-teaching to SAM and Expectation-Maximization, then develops SRIT to improve interactive teaching.

papers.title: TreeVI: Reparameterizable Tree-structured Variational Inference for Instance-level Correlation Capturing
papers.tldr: TreeVI captures posterior correlations with learnable tree structures while keeping training costs close to mean-field variational inference.

papers.title: VISA: Variational Inference with Sequential Sample-Average Approximations
papers.tldr: VISA reuses expensive model evaluations within trust regions, reporting comparable inference accuracy at half the cost or less with conservative learning rates.

papers.title: Censor Dependent Variational Inference
papers.tldr: CDVI accounts for possible censoring dependence in variational inference to improve individual survival-distribution estimates.

papers.title: Revisiting Unbiased Implicit Variational Inference
papers.tldr: Replacing UIVI’s inner MCMC loop with importance sampling and a learned proposal yields performance matching or exceeding leading benchmark methods.

papers.title: Asymptotically exact variational flows via involutive MCMC kernels
papers.tldr: The paper constructs tuning-free variational flows from involutive MCMC kernels, obtaining asymptotic convergence guarantees and competitive empirical performance.

papers.title: Fisher meets Feynman: score-based variational inference with a product of experts
papers.tldr: A Feynman identity enables sampling from expressive products of t-distribution experts, whose weights are optimized through score matching.

papers.title: HoT-VI: Reparameterizable Variational Inference for Capturing Instance-Level High-Order Correlations
papers.tldr: HoT-VI models higher-order dependencies between instances using overlapping local distributions and efficient sequential sampling.

papers.title: Learning Latent Variable Models via Jarzynski-adjusted Langevin Algorithm
papers.tldr: JALA-EM uses recursively weighted Langevin sampling to fit latent variable models and estimate marginal likelihoods for model selection.

papers.title: Least squares variational inference
papers.tldr: LSVI performs gradient-free variational inference through repeated least-squares regression, with convergence analysis and efficient Gaussian updates.

papers.title: Model-Informed Flows for Bayesian Inference
papers.tldr: Model-Informed Flows incorporate prior information, translation, and hierarchical ordering to improve Bayesian posterior approximation.

papers.title: Natural Gradient VI: Guarantees for Non-Conjugate Models
papers.tldr: The paper gives conditional convergence guarantees for non-conjugate natural-gradient variational inference, with global optimality requiring additional likelihood structure.

papers.title: Personalized Bayesian Federated Learning with Wasserstein Barycenter Aggregation
papers.tldr: FedWBA uses particle-based client posteriors and Wasserstein aggregation to improve personalized federated prediction and uncertainty estimation.

papers.title: Rao-Blackwellised Reparameterisation Gradients
papers.tldr: R2-G2 generalizes local reparameterization through Rao–Blackwellization and improves initial training in models with repeated reparameterization.

papers.title: SING: SDE Inference via Natural Gradients
papers.tldr: SING uses natural-gradient variational inference to improve hidden-state recovery and dynamics estimation in stochastic differential equation models.

papers.title: Variational Inference with Mixtures of Isotropic Gaussians
papers.tldr: The paper develops efficient variational-inference algorithms using equally weighted isotropic Gaussian mixtures to approximate multimodal posteriors.

papers.title: Variational Pólya Tree
papers.tldr: Variational Pólya trees bring Bayesian nonparametric density modeling into stochastic-gradient training while exploring interpretability and uncertainty benefits.

papers.title: Particles Don’t Care About Z: Towards Scaling Entropy Estimation of Unnormalized Densities
papers.tldr: MET-SVGD repairs theoretical and stability problems in particle-based entropy estimation and improves reported estimation and downstream results.

papers.title: Pseudo-Mallows for Efficient Probabilistic Preference Learning
papers.tldr: Pseudo-Mallows accelerates probabilistic ranking inference through a structured approximation whose quality depends on an optimized item ordering.

papers.title: Stochastic Gradient Variational Inference with Price’s Gradient Estimator from Bures-Wasserstein to Parameter Space
papers.tldr: Price's gradient lets parameter-space variational inference match Wasserstein inference's iteration guarantees, identifying the estimator as the key advantage.
